identity.display_name: 天庭战斗机制与施工前可读性合同

source_artifacts: 天庭战斗机制与可读性规格.md

party_cap.member_rule: every combat puzzle has a one-to-four-player completion path; seven-star remains solo

hard_boundaries.authority_rule: combat readability may describe pressure, decision and visible counterplay only; it must not write TT_SPEC progression, mutate membership, recompute rotation, issue credentials or alter cleanup semantics.
hard_boundaries.session_rule: existing active_to_cleanup_pending_to_closed and per-actor admission contracts remain the sole source for failure, disconnect, reentry, completion and cleanup.
hard_boundaries.economy_rule: only TT_SPEC_EVENT_LINGXIAO_OUTER_COURT_SUCCESS may currently enter the existing zero-value TT_SPEC_ECONOMY_HANDOFF_SOURCE_EVIDENCE source-fact candidate; seven-star, mansion-normal and mansion-nightmare success remain deferred and must not form handoff candidate, qualification or settlement input.
hard_boundaries.protected_difu_key_rule: DF_PROGRESS_YANLUO_HALL_CLEARED must not be read, written, registered as a consumer or substituted for the trusted DF_E_YANLUO_HALL handoff proof.
hard_boundaries.runtime_asset_rule: no map, unit, ability, item, buff, projectile, UI control, Lua, storage, timer, resource key or actual Y3 asset is created.

required_information_layers.minimum_channels: shape_or_trajectory_or_ground_projection plus one independent audio_ui_or_state_change channel

required_information_layers.required_player_information: visible state change after correct or failed counterplay

combat_grammar.accessibility_rule: color is never the sole carrier of a critical mechanic; failure must be diagnosable rather than an unexplained instant loss.

numeric_baseline_reference.rule: this readability contract keeps numeric_values null; it consumes no raw field, duration or damage value and may only require the external relative baseline to preserve P0 and counterplay before output.

encounters.reading_goal: separate visual and audio patrol warnings
identify the true formation eye before suppressing the guardian

encounters.counterplay: route, sequence or split without requiring a fifth player

encounters.reading_goal: observe changing star links before purification
encounters.counterplay: verify the stable link rather than interact blindly
preserve and purify command nodes rather than bypassing them with output

seven_star.entry_rule: single-player counterplay only; no simultaneous second-player action, external rescue or mandatory co-occupancy.

mansion_nightmare.two_way_rule: seven officers grant stellar resonance to their matching sacred beast; the sacred beast grants protection back to the same seven officers until each chain is purified.

quadrants.counterplay: purified trails reverse the hunt into a counter window
purified links open a defensible wall break

mansion_nightmare.rotation_rule: authority-frozen Asia/Shanghai rotation snapshot remains immutable for the instance; client clock, client quadrant and retry recalculation are forbidden.
mansion_nightmare.disconnect_rule: left members cannot reconnect, claim the current instance result or become a substitute participant.

handoff_boundaries.terrain: space must expose observation, decision, counterplay, retreat and interaction sightlines; this contract contains no actual coordinates, resources or terrain writes.
handoff_boundaries.object_config: future assets need silhouettes, telegraph categories and counterplay identities only; object IDs and properties remain deferred.
handoff_boundaries.lua: future runtime must consume existing authority session outcomes and cannot infer progression or settlement from a combat phase.
handoff_boundaries.ui: future UI displays authority results, dual-channel warnings and state priority only; it cannot decide entry, rotation, purification, qualification or settlement.
